caption: The drawing consists of several stylized elements arranged symmetrically on a textured, tan parchment-like background. At the top is a decorative cross outlined in red with yellow and blue interior designs, and yellow radial lines extending from the center. Below the cross is a circular motif with four long, petal-like extensions, outlined in blue and red with small yellow dots and blue and yellow interior accents, radiating from a central blue and yellow circle. To the left and right of this motif are two roughly symmetrical shapes resembling stylized gold wings with rounded tips, each accented with red tips. The bottom part of the composition features a large circular mandala-like pattern, filled with interlocking geometric and petal shapes in yellow, blue, and red, outlined in red and blue, with a small central blue circle. The overall color palette includes muted gold, red, blue, and yellow tones.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
